name: nymra-privacy-scan
description: How traceable is your wallet? Scan any EVM wallet or ENS name for its Nymra Privacy Score, every finding with its evidence, and a fix plan. The scan runs on your own computer.

alchemy_api_key.title: Alchemy API key (optional)
alchemy_api_key.description: Reads Base and Polygon PoS, whose explorers answer a browser only. Stays on this computer and goes to Alchemy only.

blockscout_api_key.title: Blockscout API key (optional)
blockscout_api_key.description: Reads Arbitrum One and Robinhood Chain, whose explorers answer a browser only. Stays on this computer and goes to Blockscout only.

nodereal_api_key.title: NodeReal API key (optional)
nodereal_api_key.description: Reads BNB Smart Chain. Stays on this computer and goes to NodeReal only.

etherscan_api_key.title: Etherscan API key (optional)
etherscan_api_key.description: Fills a gap in Polygon PoS's own index when there is one. Stays on this computer and goes to Etherscan only.
